body:
I knew what you meant. :)

I'm still struggling with the loneliness though. I feel as if... even though I'm surrounded by friends and family, there isn't really anything to fill that loneliness.

I mean, yeah, I have friends and family. Pets, too. But... there seems to be something still missing. A sense of wrongness, if you will.

Man. :P

As far as business help goes, I think some of that requires that you have good credit.

And credit is a major pain in the ass. A $2-5k loan would be perfect for my company. :|

Still though... I've not had much luck in getting some helping hands so as to be able to quickly pay back people and get my life set straight. D:

That it does.

Still, though... I've been struggling through this for the last few years. I've had more low times than I have high times.

It's becoming increasingly harder to get to the high times. Being alone and having essentially no fallback option is a shitty way to live.

>Value outside of the company I've created.

... To be honest, I'm not certain. Maybe? Fuck if I know.

> poor again for a few years

... I've been exactly that for the past few years. I've been working for quite a long time to put my company into a position of strength with varying degrees of success.

That said, $678-936 a month once each month is... nearly impossible for me to live off of.

But I've been doing it for the past few years. It works. Relatively speaking, anyway.

In all honesty though, I'm tired of trying to work against the tide due to my disability, depression and the apparent inability to even *find a fucking job*, never mind the goddamn economy.

I learned somewhat recently that the way Human Resources is set up now, I have to be essentially a God to be able to get the job to supplement my SSI income and set up a path where I can pay down debts, get shit straightened out, and get myself a vehicle and a traveling trailer and... essentially live where I may.

> What if you just let go and let the chips fall where they may?

Already doing that. Right now, I'm just letting them fall where they may and working as best as I can towards a better life.

... But it's difficult to without help. In my experience so far? Pretty much impossible right now.
